purpose: Form BEN-3 is used by the company to maintain a register of significant beneficial owners.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Board decides reasonable time for inspection.
Company maintains the register of significant beneficial owners in Form BEN-3.
Company allows inspection of the register by any member during business hours.
checklist: Business hours and reasonable time determined by the board
Payment of fee specified by the company
watch: Inspection time must be not less than two hours on every working day.
